title: The shell's skip link
assertion: On a practice page, a console page and the settings users page, at 1280 and 390 px, the link is clipped from view until focused; the first Tab shows 'Skip to the content' in view with 12 px inline and 8 px block padding and at least 24 px tall, Enter moves focus to main#content, and the next Tab lands on the first control inside main; axe 4.14 with the WCAG 2.0/2.1 A and AA tags finds no violation in the focused state (WCAG 2.4.1, 2.5.8)
noFileReason: The skip-link journey reads the shell's first tab stop and the focus after Enter in the browser; no file.
